name: Kingdom - Default (seed v1)
description: A kingdom, the territory holder above towns: it has no region of its own; its territory is its towns' territories plus its crown land (territory V1, #326).

steps.description: Name the kingdom. Towns, provinces and crown land pick their kingdom on their own forms.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique, at most 100 characters. Shown on the map and in the web app.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional, a line or two for admins.
